criterion: Require material completeness where the purpose is clearing remaining contents. Accept semantic equivalents such as remaining contents, stuck residue, emptying, or none left; do not require the literal word all. Also require material spatial-fit purposes: placing or putting bowls away in a cupboard does not by itself express making them fit better.
